State of Iowa Voter Registration Data

ELECTION DATA RESEARCH - HISTORICAL ELECTION RESULTS

To Request a Voter File:

CONTACT:  Public Records Center - Polk County Iowa

Voter Registration List Requirements

Iowa law allows for the purchase of voter registration lists (See Iowa Code section 48A.38.)

Information from voter registration records can be used only:


To request a registrant's vote at an election,

For a genuine political purpose,

For bona fide political research, or

For a bona fide official purpose by an elected official.

All List Requests must state all information that is to be requested.


Using the information for any commercial purpose is a serious misdemeanor under Iowa law.


To REQUEST Voter Files/Election Data CONTACT: Public Records Center

Election Office Questions: election@polkcountyiowa.gov
